name: text-anchor
title: Text Anchor
description: Where a comment sits in a text, stored so it survives edits — TextAnchor (offsets, quote, 80 characters of context each side), anchorFromRange and resolveAnchor (offsets → context → unique quote → orphaned). Pure strings, server-safe.

meta.whenToUse: Storing and re-finding comment anchors on a text — on the server (a save route) or in the client, with TextEdit's annotations.
meta.whenNotToUse: Positions inside a live ProseMirror document — convert with text-anchor-doc first.
